jyutping: seoi1 jin4 A daan6 hai6 B

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that B is true in spite of A.

examples.english: Despite the rain today, we’re still going hiking.
examples.traditional: 雖然今日落雨，但係我哋照樣去行山。
examples.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ziu3 joeng6 heoi3 haang4 saan1
